title: 5412 Committee, Howard Hughes and the S-force turned against JFK

tellings.quote: And the narrative I've heard is that JFK, you know, uh, fires Dulles. Dulles is sort of licking his wounds and really angry at JFK and the Brown Brothers Haramman and reoperationalizes this S force to then take out uh uh JFK

plain: One story Michels has heard goes like this: after President Kennedy fired CIA director Allen Dulles, an angry Dulles, along with the firm Brown Brothers Harriman, put a covert group called the "S force" back into action to kill Kennedy. The story's title connects it to the 5412 Committee, a Cold War body that approved secret operations, and to Howard Hughes and Richard Nixon in the 1950s and early 60s, with Cuba in the background. Michels tells it himself as "the narrative I've heard", without naming a source, in a conversation with a historian named Peter Levenda.
